name: print-social-designer-folder-portfolio-cover
title: Designer portfolio cover as a desktop with folders
whatItIs: A cream cover with an oversized script and serif title 'designer portfolio (2025)' over a big blue macOS-style folder and a cursor. Small folders and file thumbnails of social and web projects, plus app icons, float around.
whatItMeans: Familiar, witty and organised; it makes browsing a portfolio feel like opening files.
techniques: Recreate a desktop with folders and file names to present categories.
Overlap a script word on a heavy serif word for contrast.
Scatter project thumbnails as tiny file previews.
Keep a soft cream background with blue folders as the only saturated colour.

vocabulary.definition: A flowing script word laid over bold type.
A tiny image labelled like a file.
The opening slide of a deck.
